house.description: Brooklyn Park; clean water infrastructure funding provided, bonds issued, and money appropriated.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Capital Investment

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; appropriating money for clean water infrastructure in Brooklyn Park; authorizing the sale and issuance of state bonds.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+BROOKLYN PARK; WATER INFRASTRUCTURE. +]

[+Subdivision 1.+]

[+Appropriation.+]

[+$4,500,000 is appropriated from the bond proceeds fund to the city of Brooklyn Park for a grant to predesign, design, construct, acquire right-of-way and easements, and equip improvements to the city's water distribution system including two water mains that will connect from the east to west under marked U.S. Highway 169 north of marked Trunk Highway 610, one water main that will connect from the north to south under marked Trunk Highway 610 west of marked U.S. Highway 169, and supporting connections between the new crossings to support the city's biotech innovation district. +]

[+Subd. 2.+]

[+Bond sale.+]

[+To provide the money appropriated in this section from the bond proceeds fund, the commissioner of management and budget shall sell and issue bonds of the state in an amount up to $4,500,000 in the manner, upon the terms, and with the effect prescribed by Minnesota Statutes, sections 16A.631 to 16A.675, and by the Minnesota Constitution, article XI, sections 4 to 7. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; appropriating money for clean water infrastructure in Brooklyn Park; authorizing the sale and issuance of state bonds.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. BROOKLYN PARK; WATER INFRASTRUCTURE.

Subdivision 1.

Appropriation.

$4,500,000 is appropriated from the bond proceeds fund to the city of Brooklyn Park for a grant to predesign, design, construct, acquire right-of-way and easements, and equip improvements to the city's water distribution system including two water mains that will connect from the east to west under marked U.S. Highway 169 north of marked Trunk Highway 610, one water main that will connect from the north to south under marked Trunk Highway 610 west of marked U.S. Highway 169, and supporting connections between the new crossings to support the city's biotech innovation district.

Subd. 2.

Bond sale.

To provide the money appropriated in this section from the bond proceeds fund, the commissioner of management and budget shall sell and issue bonds of the state in an amount up to $4,500,000 in the manner, upon the terms, and with the effect prescribed by Minnesota Statutes, sections 16A.631 to 16A.675, and by the Minnesota Constitution, article XI, sections 4 to 7.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
additions: $4,500,000 is appropriated from the bond proceeds fund to the city of Brooklyn Park for a grant to predesign, design, construct, acquire right-of-way and easements, and equip improvements to the city's water distribution system including two water mains that will connect from the east to west under marked U.S. Highway 169 north of marked Trunk Highway 610, one water main that will connect from the north to south under marked Trunk Highway 610 west of marked U.S. Highway 169, and supporting connections between the new crossings to support the city's biotech innovation district.

To provide the money appropriated in this section from the bond proceeds fund, the commissioner of management and budget shall sell and issue bonds of the state in an amount up to $4,500,000 in the manner, upon the terms, and with the effect prescribed by Minnesota Statutes, sections 16A.631 to 16A.675, and by the Minnesota Constitution, article XI, sections 4 to 7.
This section is effective the day following final enactment.
